comments.text:
Hi Mr. Ferreira,

Thank you for your bug report.

However, it is not a bug.

That is expected behaviour. If you are setting any of ACID attributes to the unsafe values, you can expect exactly the kind of behaviour that you have described.

This is particularly true for innodb_fast_shutdown. As our Manual says:

"
Use innodb_fast_shutdown=2 in emergency or troubleshooting situations, to get the absolute fastest shutdown if data is at risk of corruption.
"

Combination of these two, particularly when you perform a full-table DDL can truly lead to problems.

Not a bug.
